for: a deployment that applied ONLY patch/266-token-drift-fix; rolls up every post-266 customer-facing fix (former 311-rollup: #290/#298/#300/#303/#304/#305/#306/#307/#312/#314) PLUS #315 (concurrent-tenant dispatch: remove host-level inflight gate in ddb mode + host-agent reconciler race fixes + scaler idle auto-scale-down off).
note: cdk deploy is FORBIDDEN (this deployment was CDK-deployed once then hand-modified; a deploy would overwrite the manual changes). All shipped files are a byte-for-byte snapshot of the public gateway branch HEAD. APPLY-INSTRUCTIONS.md carries the commands we test-verified; the operator/AI adapts placeholders (<region>/<host>/<key>/resource names) to the target environment. Backup only the minimal set below (the files/functions this patch actually replaces) — nothing else is touched.

verify_source_before_apply.why: Each shipped artifact must equal its SOURCE file in the repo at patch_sha — this catches a mis-packaged (張冠李戴) patch before you push anything to the live system. For each entry in 'replaces', `source` is the repo path and `sha256` is that file's SHA-256 at patch_sha; the shipped `artifact` must hash to the same value.
verify_source_before_apply.how: In a checkout of the gateway branch at patch_sha (or compare against the shipped artifact directly): `git show <patch_sha>:<source> | shasum -a 256` must equal the entry's `sha256`, AND `shasum -a 256 <artifact>` must equal it too. All hashes here are SHA-256 (not SHA-1 — a tool defaulting to SHA-1 will show a false mismatch).
verify_source_before_apply.dir_case: For the api tree (a directory, not one file), verify the file COUNT matches (36 files at patch_sha under deploy/lambda/api) and spot-check the #315-changed files: core/clients.py, core/dispatch/binpack.py, services/dispatch_poller.py, services/dispatch_service.py.

launch-vm.sh.why: #290/#306 token fallback + rc=127 fix, #301 default-template skip-S3, #312/#314 paired.json/vkey re-inject, #315 ddb-mode non-zero-exit keeps assignment pending. Cumulative.

host-agent.py.why: #315 reconciler race fixes (_recovering leak, failed-launch keeps pending, health-gated promote). New in #315.
host-agent.py.restart_caveat: host-agent.service has no KillMode -> default control-group -> `systemctl restart` SIGTERMs the whole cgroup and kills EVERY tenant firecracker on that host. Set KillMode=process (drop-in) BEFORE restart. See APPLY Step 4.

api-tree.verify: compare file count (36) + spot-check the #315-changed files; whole-tree, not a single sha256
